result_text:
Promotions now carry an optional description, and it comes back in all six listings plus the lookup by code. The full suite passes (612 tests). Nothing is committed.

- **`schema.sql`**: new nullable `description VARCHAR(200)` column on `promotion`.
- **`model/Promotion.java`**: `description` added as the last record component, documented as null when none was given.
- **`service/PromotionService.java`**: new 6-argument `createPromotion(..., category, description)`. A blank description is stored as null, like a blank category. The existing 5-argument method delegates with no description, so current callers are unchanged.
- **`DataStore.java`**: the insert writes the description. The promotion-by-code, active-on-date, active-in-region, by-category, best-for-category, and unused-in-period queries select it and pass it to the record.
- **`PromotionTest.java`**: new `keepsDescriptionInAllListings` test. It creates SUMMER with "Summer sale on all hardware" and checks that text in every listing and in the code lookup. It also checks that a promotion without a description, and one with a blank description, come back with null.

I did not change `DemoScenario`, so the demo data still has no descriptions. I also did not add a Java-side migration because the database is rebuilt from `schema.sql` at startup.
